title: Laredo Police Chief Shares Thanksgiving Message, Thanks Officers and City Leaders
excerpt: Laredo Police Chief Miguel A. Rodriguez Jr. shared a Thanksgiving message thanking every sworn and civilian member of the department for their dedication to serving the community, and wishing Laredo families a blessed, peaceful and happy holiday.
content:
Laredo Police Chief Miguel A. Rodriguez Jr. shared a Thanksgiving message for the department and the community on Thursday, Nov. 26, 2026.

Chief Rodriguez thanked every member of the Laredo Police Department, both sworn and civilian personnel, for their dedication, professionalism, and commitment to serving the community, saying their hard work and sacrifices make a meaningful difference every day and help make Laredo the Safest City in Texas.

He also thanked the City of Laredo Mayor, City Council, and City Management for their continued support, leadership, and commitment to providing the department with the resources it needs to fulfill its mission.

Chief Rodriguez wished the LPD family and the citizens of Laredo a blessed, peaceful, and happy Thanksgiving.
